title.en: Sampling errors, non-sampling errors and data agencies
title.kn: ಮಾದರಿ ದೋಷ, ಮಾದರಿಯೇತರ ದೋಷ ಮತ್ತು ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು

heading.en: Where can a survey go wrong?

hook.en: Two surveys of the same town give different average incomes. One picked fewer homes; the other had an investigator who wrote numbers wrongly. Are these the same kind of error?
hook.kn: ಒಂದೇ ಊರಿನ ಎರಡು ಸಮೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳು ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಸರಾಸರಿ ಆದಾಯ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಒಂದರಲ್ಲಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮನೆಗಳು, ಇನ್ನೊಂದರಲ್ಲಿ ತಪ್ಪು ದಾಖಲೆ. ಇವು ಒಂದೇ ರೀತಿಯ ದೋಷವೇ?

narration.en: Two surveys of the same town give different average incomes. One picked fewer homes; the other had an investigator who wrote numbers wrongly. Are these the same kind of error?

body.en: Sampling error is the difference between the sample estimate and the true population value; it arises because only a part is studied and falls as the sample size rises. Non-sampling errors arise from errors in data acquisition (wrong answers, recording mistakes), non-response, and sampling bias; they can occur even in a census.
body.kn: ಮಾದರಿ ಅಂದಾಜು ಮತ್ತು ನಿಜವಾದ ಮೌಲ್ಯದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾದರಿ ದೋಷ; ಮಾದರಿ ಗಾತ್ರ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದಂತೆ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ತಪ್ಪು ದಾಖಲೆ, ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಇಲ್ಲದಿರುವುದು ಮಾದರಿಯೇತರ ದೋಷಗಳು.

points.en: Sampling error = sample estimate − population value
Non-sampling: acquisition errors, non-response, sampling bias

say.en: Four students scored 40, 50, 60 and 70. The population mean is 55.
A sample of the first two gives a mean of 45. The gap is the sampling error.
Sampling error falls as the sample grows. Non-sampling errors can occur even in a census.
The Census of India is held every ten years. The NSO runs regular sample surveys.

body.en: The Census of India, held every 10 years since 1881, collects data on population size, density, sex ratio and literacy. The National Statistical Office (formed in 2019 by merging NSSO and CSO) conducts regular sample surveys on employment, consumer expenditure, literacy and health.
body.kn: ಭಾರತದ ಜನಗಣತಿ 1881ರಿಂದ ಪ್ರತಿ 10 ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೊಮ್ಮೆ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಕಚೇರಿ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ, ಅನುಭೋಗ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮುಂತಾದ ಮಾದರಿ ಸಮೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಡೆಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Census: every 10 years (Registrar General of India)
NSO: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
Other agencies: RBI, Labour Bureau, Directorate General of Commercial Intelligence and Statistics
